completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2776_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 3 条，缺 2）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en:
Project Numbered B-221.25, for the Province of Iloilo, page 464-A, Title B-Highways (Feeder and Secondary Roads), Appendix A of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen is amended to read as follows:
"B-221.25 Guimbal-Igbaras Road. Construction of bridges GR 8.00 8.00 8.00 4"
Section 2. Priority Numbered 19, Group I, for the province of Iloilo, page 42-B, Appendix B of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"19 Miagao—Pungtod-Cavite Construction 5,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
